title: Tuesday Night Meditation and Dharma Teaching                                                          (We have moved to NEST RALEIGH)
location_address: 414 Fayetteville St Ave, Raleigh 4th floor (email or text for door code)
description:
Please note - There is NO CLASS this Tuesday (10/6), we will pick up again on 10/13.
We now meet every Tuesday evening at NEST CO-WORKING SPACE,
414 Fayetteville Street - 4th floor.  For the door code send an email to info@sitraleigh.com or text me at 919-306-9495. (if you already have the code it stays the same)

For our teaching on Tuesday 10/13 we continue the unpacking of the Noble Eight-fold Path. This week's topic are the Ethics Factors of Wise Action, Wise Speech and Wise Livelihood. We begin with a 25-30 minute meditation and finish with the Dharma talk. All are welcome. Class by Dana (generosity). 
Parking is free after 6pm on the street (in legal spaces) in downtown Raleigh. We are also on Zoom if you cannot make it in person. (To join just click the register link button and you will join the meeting)
